### Blocking

- [BLOCKING] The added `os.unlink(os.path.join(directory, name))` follows a symlinked archive directory. Reproduced with rotation/archive pointing to another project's archive: SessionStart deleted that project's older handover. Leaf-file checks do not protect ancestor directories. Reject symlinked storage directories and anchor deletions to a verified directory. (original severity: error)

### Advisory

- The added `_unlink_logged(project_dir, marker["handover"])` can delete a newer handover. Write/Edit do not acquire the project lock, so they can replace the file after read_bytes captures the old bytes but before unlink. A deterministic reproduction deleted the newer content while the archive contained only the old content. Preserve the original unless writers participate in an atomic ownership protocol. (severity: warning)
- The added `if isinstance(field, str) and os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(field)) == archive:` resolves unvalidated marker data. An archive string containing a NUL raises ValueError. Reproduced with an existing archive directory: trimming fails before SessionStart can inject or list handovers, and subsequent starts repeat the failure. Validate the path and handle malformed fields before resolving them. (severity: warning)
- ADR-005: the added `os.rename(source, target)` persists the claim transition before any canonical NDJSON event. injections.jsonl is appended only later, after archiving; a crash after claiming leaves the ownership decision recorded solely in a JSON marker. Append a canonical claim event before changing ownership or writing derived state. (severity: warning)
